capability: Pay the prepared spell's casting cost, including declared X, before casting its copy

oracle_requirements.text:
This creature enters prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
Target player gains X life.

required_scenarios: Casting Stream of Life with X=0 pays {G}; X=4 pays {4}{G}.
Insufficient mana or an invalid target leaves mana, prepared state, and stack unchanged.
A successful cast unprepares the creature and stores X and the selected player.
A copy of the spell retains X and can change its target independently.
Casting follows the spell's timing and does not introduce a separate activated-ability stack object.
evidence: Code audit: WithPreparedSpell installs a zero-mana activated ability; CastPreparedSpellCopy directly calls pushCastSpellObject without a mana-payment transaction.
The existing TestInfirmaryHealer_StreamOfLifeUnprepares uses X=0 without providing mana. This is legacy coverage, not evidence of correct cost payment.
No new failing payment regression or engine correction is included in the Bake into a Pie migration. Confirm the audit with an engine regression before implementation.
